title: package.json metadata does not describe how the project runs: main points at dist/index.js (no such entry), there is no start script and no engines field although the installed native SQLite module needs Node 22 (ABI 127), and build compiles hardhat.config.ts into dist/

evidence.note: "main": "dist/index.js"; there is no src/index.ts and dist/ is not tracked (git ls-tree at the base)
no start script; README.md:34 and :217 document npx ts-node src/bot.ts
no engines field; D-21 records that only Node 22.16.0 (ABI 127) loads the installed better-sqlite3, and Node 24 fails to load it (fails closed)
"build": "tsc" with tsconfig.json, whose include adds hardhat.config.ts (tsconfig.json:15); nothing runs dist/

sibling_sites_checked: package.json at the base only; the start command changes with plan 22-13 (src/main.ts), re-audited in 22-29.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene; a wrong Node version fails closed at load.
recommendation: Phase 25: set main to the real entry (or remove it), add a start script for the lock-first entry (plan 22-13), and an engines field per OD-13.
